name: Link Contact to Call Summary
plugin_description: Sync medications, pharmacies, and providers from call transcripts to Contact records
action_description: Fetches the phone call record, asserts exactly one contact is linked, then patches the call summary record (<call_name> Summary) to set its primary_contact_record field

inputs.name: call_summary_id
inputs.label: Call Summary ID
inputs.description: UUID of the call summary record to patch with the contact association.

inputs.name: call_name
inputs.label: Phone Call Name
inputs.description: Name of the phone call record to look up and link its related contact to the call summary.

outputs.name: contact_id
outputs.label: Contact ID
outputs.description: UUID of the contact that was linked to the call summary
